posts.text: Yang Mun is an AI character created by Shalev Hani. We studied two Shorts and the public $49.99 journey and $59.99 collection with three eBooks. The sales path is visible; audited net profit is not public. Read the free, sourced case study: https://aniccaai.com/blog/ebook-publishing-yang-mun-video-to-product?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ai_monk_yangmun_en

AI monk avatars are not one business model. Our five-profile starter directory separates confirmed, reported, and unverified profiles, maps visible offers, and marks what public sources cannot prove. Free field guide + open dataset: https://aniccaai.com/blog/ebook-publishing-ai-monk-economy-2026?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ai_monk_field_en

Yang MunのAI僧侶ビジネスを、公開Shorts 2本・$49.99の30日プログラム・$59.99のeBookセットから検証。販売導線は見える一方、監査済みの利益は公開資料から確認できません。無料の日本語ケーススタディ: https://aniccaai.com/blog/ebook-publishing-yang-mun-case-study-ja?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ai_monk_yangmun_ja

AI僧侶アバター関連の初期5プロフィールを、AI生成の根拠・動画の型・商品導線・未確認点に分けて整理。Yang Munだけを市場全体と見なさず、Ming Sanらの確度も併記した無料ガイドです。公開JSON付き: https://aniccaai.com/blog/ai-monk-avatar-field-guide-ja-2026?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ai_monk_field_ja
